title: チケゾー配達日記～蒸気編～

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket has invited me to play a VR game along with Biwa Hayahide and Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You want us to deliver more coal?! This delivery mission should be over already!

text_block_list.name: Village Mayor
text_block_list.text: You're free to quit if you don't like it. "A fool will work to no end, but the wise will prove themselves." Heh-heh, run along now.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: What an awesome saying, Mayor! Woohoo, I'm going to become the delivery master!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm… We're on our third additional request. Very strange indeed. This can only mean…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: We need to find a different way to progress. The mayor said that "the wise will prove themselves"…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Come on guys, let's get going! Those villagers are counting on that coal!
choice_data_list: Wait, Ticket! Hold on just a—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right! Time to lug this coal to its destination! You three can catch up later!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh… It's useless. Talking her down when she gets like that is impossible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's true. I'll go keep an eye on her. Maybe there will be some clues to find along the way.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… I'm back, Mayor! I delivered the coal, just like you asked!

text_block_list.name: Village Mayor
text_block_list.text: How foolish… Then your next task will be to deliver one hundred parcels. Now listen again—"A fool will work to no end, but the wise will prove—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whooooa! That's a ton of parcels, but I've got you! I'll deliver them lickety-split!

text_block_list.name: Village Mayor
text_block_list.text: H-hey! Can't you let me finish?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Winning Ticket powers through the mayor's unreasonable demands, one after another…

text_block_list.name: Village Mayor
text_block_list.text: Grrr! You mean you've delivered all those, too? N-next is… Oh, right! The flyers! I want you to—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah! I've actually distributed all the flyers already! I also helped organize stock at the market and tidied up the coal mine!

text_block_list.name: Village Mayor
text_block_list.text: You what?! Geez… I've never met someone this thickheaded…

text_block_list.name: Village Mayor
text_block_list.text: …Didn't you find my requests odd? One task after another, all of them excessively tedious.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's so odd about that? This village seems like it's in a real bind.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: There's so much work to do around here. It's all backed up!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And that's why I'm doing all these errands! Being able to help you and the other villagers makes me so, so…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Incredibly HAPPY!

text_block_list.name: Village Mayor
text_block_list.text: Hm… You said your name was Tickezo, correct? Here, please accept this reward. Also… the entire village hopes that you'll visit again.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: According to the game data, it appears that Ticket has maxed out her affinity level with the mayor.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …It's not the standard way to progress, but by boosting her affinity with the mayor, Ticket forced the mission to completion.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! I don't really get how, but we cleared the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh… This takes me back to our early days at Tracen.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Cheers to all of us getting accepted into Tracen! Let's take a photo to celebrate, come on!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Student
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um… you do realize we're going to be competing as rivals, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's true! We are rivals, but…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I want us to embrace the joy of this moment! Then when it comes time to race, we can give it our all! Let's become rivals and friends!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Student
text_block_list.text: …Hehe, I like the way you think. Okay, let's all take a picture together—as friends.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh, that time… Everyone just gathered together all of a sudden. I remember thinking Ticket was some goody-goody, nothing like me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But an enrollment ceremony is a super special occasion! And it makes it all that much better when everyone's happy!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe… You've always been someone who thinks about others and acts for their benefit. That hasn't changed at all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Yeah, I guess. You're always putting yourself in someone else's shoes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, and you never fail to move people's hearts with your actions. That includes us.
choice_data_list: She's always around to lend a helping hand.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, and you never fail to move people's hearts with your actions. That includes us.
choice_data_list: She's always around to lend a helping hand.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: …I am?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I bet the secret behind it all is her complete selflessness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today has been a vivid reminder of the genuine affection that Winning Ticket has for others.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oooh! That's a great idea, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh. Count me out. That's really not my vibe…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I personally think it's a great way to show our thanks to Ticket. Plus, talking her down when she gets like this is impossible, no?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To celebrate clearing the mission, we all bunch up around Winning Ticket for a group photo!
